svg.aria-label: Two panels. A CPU: 4 large cores, each fast for 1 thread, above a large cache that keeps data near the cores. A GPU: a field of 128 small squares standing for thousands of simple arithmetic units, above small caches; most of its area goes to arithmetic.
svg.text: Where a CPU and a GPU spend their chip area
A CPU avoids waiting for memory; a GPU hides the wait behind other threads.
a few large cores, each fast alone
